newsitem.title: UK: Willis Corroon up after nine months results.
newsitem.headline: Willis Corroon up after nine months results.

text.p: Shares in Willis Corroon Plc, the British-based international insurance broking group, rose in early trading on Wednesday after the company reported better than expected nine-month pretax profits.
Willis Corroon shares gained 3p to 132p by 0838 GMT. Some 128,000 shares had been traded.
The company reported a 17 percent rise in pretax profits in the first nine months to 88.2 million stg. Analysts had forecast profits in a range of 73 million to 80.5 million stg.
The company attributed gains in part to the results of a recent internal review.
"Willis Corroon's growth of revenues and cost control is impressive," said one industry analyst. "These results were more impressive than Sedgwick's."
Sedgwick Plc, the UK-based insurance broker reported third quarter earnings of 80.4 million stg earlier this week, which again beat analysts' best expectations.
